factsPolicy: Published facts and commercial terms are sourced; recommendations are hypotheses. No response, acceptance or payment is implied.

programmes.name: Zonky / Air Bank
programmes.offer: Spotřebitelský úvěr včetně financování nákupu auta
programmes.network: Own programme / AffilBox; an additional published eSpolupráce route uses TUNE
programmes.commissionModel: Referral commission; own public page does not specify payable event/rate
programmes.publishedRequirements: Own route requests a partner profile and website domain, then offers advertising assets. No public traffic minimum found.
programmes.contentRules: Use approved current credit assets and representative example. Historical eSpolupráce article describes CPS 1.75% / 2.10% with repayment insurance, but contains stale product parameters; treat those percentages as historical published terms requiring reconfirmation, not current quoted commission.
programmes.unverified: Current rate, approval criteria, payout minimum, validation period, calculator availability and legal role.
programmes.assessment: Directly matches the requested financing block. Ask for an approved hosted widget; do not copy competitor rates or build an unauthorised credit comparison.

programmes.name: Cofidis
programmes.offer: Consumer loans and merchant instalment finance
programmes.network: Own merchant route; eSpolupráce published a CZ affiliate launch
programmes.commissionModel: Not established on current public pages
programmes.publishedRequirements: Merchant partnership is not proof that a small content publisher qualifies. Network announcement identifies Czech targeting.
programmes.contentRules: Credit rules apply. Obtain current campaign approval and current assets; historical article is not a current rate card.
programmes.unverified: Whether CZ publisher campaign is currently open, event/rate, domain approval and minimum traffic.
programmes.assessment: Credible alternative to ask about after Zonky, without promising campaign acceptance.

programmes.name: Home Credit
programmes.commissionModel: Not published for our publisher use case
programmes.publishedRequirements: Published partner area concerns merchants, contractual onboarding and finance integration; not an open content-affiliate offer.
programmes.contentRules: Credit rules; no collection of applicants’ financial data in our proposed first integration.
programmes.unverified: Publisher eligibility, car-related referral terms and remuneration.
programmes.assessment: Longer onboarding than a ready-made publisher link; avoid treating merchant finance as an immediately available affiliate product.

programmes.name: Ušetřeno.cz
programmes.offer: Povinné ručení / havarijní and other comparison services

publishedCommission.event: Autopojištění — lead created; visitor leaves contact on provider comparison

programmes.publishedRequirements: Publisher application and approval; website/social publishers addressed. No numeric traffic minimum on public page.
programmes.contentRules: Start with click-out to provider-controlled flow. Embedded form/API is advertised but requires separate commercial, privacy and regulatory review.
programmes.unverified: Duplicates/rejections, cookie window, payout threshold and timing, permission to prefill vehicle data.
programmes.assessment: Clear published automotive CPL makes this the first insurance enquiry. Approval and realised revenue remain uncertain.

programmes.name: Klik.cz & ePojisteni.cz

programmes.commissionModel: Not established from a current campaign rate card
programmes.publishedRequirements: Network publisher signup and campaign acceptance; exact limits require confirmation.
programmes.contentRules: Provider terms distinguish referral-only third parties from insurance mediation. Do not recommend a policy based on personal circumstances or collect lead data without an agreed flow.
programmes.unverified: Current CPL/CPA basis, rates, eligible insurance products and validation conditions.
programmes.assessment: Ask network for a current motor-insurance card; do not import commission values from unaffiliated directories.

programmes.name: Top-Pojištění.cz
programmes.network: Own partnership; current route to confirm
programmes.commissionModel: Commission linked to concluded policy volume in a dated official presentation
programmes.publishedRequirements: Official 2020 document discusses partner onboarding, iframe and link integration; not proof of an active offer on current terms.
programmes.contentRules: Obtain a current motor-insurance agreement; link-out first.
programmes.unverified: Current programme status, corporate purchasing route and rates.
programmes.assessment: Historical lead only. Avoid assuming it is an independent diversification opportunity from Ušetřeno; group relationship needs checking.

programmes.name: Cebia

publishedCommission.event: Paid Cebia certificate; current opened campaign shows fixed 100 Kč

programmes.publishedRequirements: Network/domain registration and campaign admission. No numeric traffic minimum found.
programmes.contentRules: Campaign prohibits coupon-site promotion and PPC; use approved content placement. Search snippets showed a conflicting older percentage: opened current campaign is the recorded source.
programmes.unverified: Publisher acceptance, payout threshold, cancellation policy and VIN-prefilled deep links.
programmes.assessment: High-intent complement to free aggregate context; also a data competitor. Keep editorial conclusions independent.

programmes.name: carVertical
programmes.network: Own programme; current signup points to Everflow (legacy login link also present)
programmes.publishedRequirements: Public page says free signup, no minimum traffic or sales volume, non-exclusive; application still required. Rate negotiated on entry; 90-day attribution stated.
programmes.contentRules: Use provider terms/approved assets; PPC permission must be confirmed. Do not turn a missing report record into a clean-history guarantee.
programmes.unverified: Actual rate, payout minimum, market-specific contract and acceptance of our site.
programmes.assessment: Especially approachable for a small publisher because lack of minimum traffic is explicitly published. Alternative VIN partner to Cebia; avoid cluttering every page with both.

programmes.name: autoDNA

programmes.publishedRequirements: Application reviewed before activation; car-focused and broader content websites addressed.
programmes.contentRules: Use licensed marketing assets and confirm allowed channels in terms.
programmes.unverified: Our rate, attribution, minimum payout, refunds and eligibility.
programmes.assessment: Third report provider to compare if Cebia/carVertical terms are unsuitable; competitor risk remains.

programmes.name: Automato

programmes.publishedRequirements: No public publisher admission criteria found.
programmes.contentRules: Ask about service area, completed-booking attribution, cancellations, liability and whether an advert-specific referral is accepted. No invented per-booking fee.
programmes.unverified: Whether paid referral partnership is offered; all commercial terms.
programmes.assessment: Strong contextual fit and potential B2B data customer. An enquiry is a negotiation, not an affiliate application to a confirmed programme.

programmes.unverified: Referral model and whether company contact accepts partnership proposals.
programmes.assessment: Potential referral/data partner, but evidence of demand or willingness to pay is absent.

programmes.name: AUTO REVIZE
programmes.publishedRequirements: No public programme criteria found; website has contact form.
programmes.contentRules: Confirm actual coverage/capacity and completed-booking terms. No personal contact details retained.
programmes.assessment: Small-service pilot may have a shorter decision path; this is a sales hypothesis.

programmes.name: Driveto

programmes.unverified: Our admission, final contract, payout timing and applicable tax treatment.
programmes.assessment: Published actionable terms, but new-car lease intent is weaker on a used-car advert. Test later on relevant model/budget pages.

programmes.unverified: Acceptance, commission, traffic or volume requirement.
